headline: MARIMACA EXTENDS PAMPA MEDINA BORNITE 300M SOUTH — 6M AT 6.11% CU, 40M AT 2.04% CU OPENS TIER-ONE SCALE (TSX:MARI)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Marimaca Copper Corp.
snippet: Marimaca Copper (TSX:MARI) reported July 7 that SPRD-07 at Pampa Medina in Chile's Antofagasta Region extended the ultra-high-grade bornite zone 300m south, returning 20m at 2.65% Cu from 564m including 6m at 6.11% Cu and 24.0 g/t Ag, plus 40m at 2.04% Cu at 664m — a third consecutive step-out confirming a stacked manto-type copper-silver architecture at potential tier-one scale. SPRD-08B separately intersected mineralization in basement metasediments for the first time, opening a depth extension below previously mapped host units and significantly expanding the exploration vector at Chile's most-watched new copper sulphide discovery.

headline: MADSEN AUSTIN 904: 53.87 G/T AU OVER 3.1M IN PRISTINE UNMINED PANEL — WRLG SEQUENCES INTO H1 2027 MINE PLAN (TSXV:WRLG)
source_name: GlobeNewswire / West Red Lake Gold Mines Ltd.
snippet: West Red Lake Gold Mines (TSXV:WRLG) released July 7 drill results from Madsen Mine in Red Lake: 43.38 g/t Au over 3.85m and 53.87 g/t Au over 3.1m from the Austin 955 Complex, plus 10.22 g/t Au over 13.35m including a 69.85 g/t Au high-grade core over 1.1m from the Austin 904 Complex — a ~200m × 200m panel of gold mineralization that was never historically extracted. The Austin 904 represents a rare intact zone at a deposit where most high-grade material was partially mined decades ago, and the company is targeting it for larger, more efficient stopes in the H1 2027 production sequence.

headline: BALLYWIRE: 6.9M AT 18.3% ZN+PB IN 50M STEP-OUT — IRELAND ZINC DISCOVERY REACHES 3.2KM STRIKE, CU-AG ZONE EXTENDS TO 700M (TSXV:ZNG)
snippet: Group Eleven Resources (TSXV:ZNG) confirmed July 7 that four new holes at the Ballywire discovery in Ireland returned 6.9m at 18.3% Zn+Pb and 86 g/t Ag in a 50m step-out and 45m at 6.0% Zn+Pb in a broader interval, while the deeper Cu-Ag zone extended from 430m to 700m of strike length. The discovery now spans 3.2km of a 6km-prospective trend, with germanium — a critical semiconductor mineral found in Irish-type carbonate-hosted zinc deposits — formally part of the critical minerals angle around the project following China's germanium export controls.

headline: NEVADA KING EAST RIDGE: 4.68 G/T AU FROM 22M DEPTH, 1.00 G/T OVER 26.8M — NEW GOLD ZONE OPENS OUTSIDE ATLANTA PIT (TSXV:NKG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Nevada King Gold Corp.
snippet: Nevada King Gold (TSXV:NKG) reported July 7 that RAB reconnaissance drilling at the East Ridge Target returned 4.68 g/t Au over 7.3m from 21.9m depth and 1.00 g/t Au over 26.8m from 2.4m depth — both near-surface intercepts that bottomed in mineralization and are located immediately east of the Atlanta pit at the company's 130 km² Atlanta Mine Project in eastern Nevada. Follow-up RC drilling awaits BLM approval for the fifth Plan of Operations modification; the RAB program is expanding Atlanta's resource envelope faster than the deeper rig can chase — the setup that historically precedes a significant step-out.

headline: SORRENTO DRILLS 52M AT 0.98% TREO AT BOTTOM BROOK — CARBONATITE REE SYSTEM EXPANDS IN NEWFOUNDLAND (CSE:SRS)
snippet: Sorrento Resources (CSE:SRS) provided a July 7 drilling update on its Bottom Brook rare earth project in Newfoundland, with a new hole returning 52m at 0.98% TREO — the widest interval reported at the project — within a program now exceeding 1,000 metres across six holes and expanding to 10 holes totalling approximately 1,500 metres. The Bottom Brook REE distribution mirrors the giant Bayan Obo carbonatite system in China, and the monazite-enriched horizon architecture suggests a large-scale, bulk-mineable deposit style at a time when Western rare earth supply diversification is a national security and industrial policy priority.

headline: ROSLAND CAPITAL BANKRUPT — GOLD DEALER COLLAPSE EXPOSES COUNTERPARTY RISK RETAIL INVESTORS IGNORED
snippet: Money Metals published a July 6 analysis of Rosland Capital's bankruptcy filing — one of the largest US retail precious metals dealer collapses in recent memory — arguing that customers who stored metal through the company face uncertain recovery prospects while those who took direct physical delivery are unaffected. The piece is a pointed reminder for retail investors that in precious metals, the structure of your purchase — allocated storage, direct delivery, ETF, or dealer-held — determines whether you own gold or merely a claim on a counterparty, a distinction that only becomes visible in a default scenario.

headline: CHINA 790+ TONNES SILVER IMPORTED IN EARLY 2026 — SOLAR DEMAND DRIVES STRATEGIC BUYING AS WESTERN SUPPLY TIGHTENS
snippet: GoldSeek's Gold SWOT analysis highlights that China imported over 790 tonnes of silver in early 2026 — demand driven primarily by domestic solar panel manufacturing at a time when China has simultaneously reclassified silver as a strategic material and controls an estimated 60-70% of global refined silver capacity. For junior silver mining investors, the import surge is structurally bullish: it absorbs available global supply while Chinese production remains directed domestically, tightening the physical market for the Western producers — Canadian, Mexican, and Australian juniors — that represent the swing supply.

headline: CARMACKS FIRST HITS: CASCADIA DRILLS 106.62M AT 1.09% CUEQ IN YUKON'S LARGEST 2026 COPPER PROGRAM
source_name: Investing News Network / Cascadia Minerals Ltd.
snippet: Cascadia Minerals' first assay results from the fully-funded 2026 exploration program at Carmacks in Yukon returned Hole CD-26-046 at Zone 2000S with 106.62m at 0.79% Cu and 0.28 g/t Au (1.09% CuEq), and CD-26-041 at Zone 147 with 98.16m at 0.92% Cu — both materially exceeding the resource model's predictions, an early positive surprise in what is the largest drill campaign at Carmacks since 2007. The project has road and grid access in a stable Canadian jurisdiction, and the 15,000-metre programme is targeting multiple zones outside the current resource boundary with first-pass results already outperforming the geological model.

headline: J.P. MORGAN $5,055 BASE CASE GOLD BY Q4, $6,000 BULL — JUNIOR OPTIONALITY PREMIUM REBUILDS AS TARGETS EXCEED SPOT BY 22%
snippet: Canadian Mining Report's July 2026 gold price analysis summarises J.P. Morgan's projection of gold averaging $5,055 per ounce by Q4 2026 — a 22% premium to current spot near $4,143 — with a bull case reaching $6,000 if the Fed holds rates through summer and dollar weakness accelerates. For junior gold mining investors, the gap between current gold prices and analyst targets is what drives optionality premium in exploration stocks: a $5,055 base case changes the economics of every 2026 PEA and resource estimate currently in preparation, making under-valued juniors with near-term catalysts the most leveraged expression of the bull thesis.
